Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the major 
maintenance procedures P1, which must be performed every five years as indicated by Y5 in 
above title block.
The turning gear used for turning the 
rotor of turbine with low speed during shutdown and reach its zero speed.
Technical 
specification
Input speed 1670 rpm
Speed of satellite carrier 215.5 1 / min
Speed ratio 7.75
Overrunning clutch 800 rpm
Speed of pump wheel 1670 rpm
Min. oil pressure of pump wheel 0.05 MPa
Slip 0.5 %
Output 
speed 70 72 rpm
Transmitting torque moment 63 Nm
Lubricating oil pressure 0.1 0.17 MPa
The first draft initiated & tested by eng. 
Medat Fouad Saafan, 
accepted by eng. Mohammed 
Farag Ismaiel: general director, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Samir Abd El Gilil; EDEPC inspection & quality 
control's general director, and approved by eng.
Fathy Mahmod Ragap head sector of Talkha Power Station 
2x210MW.
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil; 
 EDEPC inspection & quality control's general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman 
 EDEPC admin & financial inspection & quality control's general director and 
 supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance stuff should be 
 carrying the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment as
 safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs.
Isolate the circuit breaker of the turning gear motor.
Disconnect electric terminals of the turning gear 
 motor.
Isolate the turning gear 
 mechanically by cutoff the input oil.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid, Manual puller.
Feeler gauge, Dial indicator
Vibrometer, Straight edge, 
 Grease gun
Rags,
 Soft brush, Oil can.
Work to be Carried Out
Disassembly
Turning gear in 
Operation
Measure vibrations level for bearings and 
 compare it with the setting value, then analyze it and determine what to do.
Check revolution of turbine rotor and compare 
 it with the setting value then analyze it and 
 determine what to do.
Turning gear 
Out of Operation
Remove the pelt drive of the motor.
Shift electric motor away from the Turning 
 gear.
Disconnect auxiliary piping of oil.
Screw out screw fixing bracket base to base 
 plate.
Attach carrying rope to the upper Turning gear.
Take out carefully the whole Turning gear and 
 put it on out side table.
Dismantling the shift in hydraulic part.
Dismantling Hydrodynamical coujpling.
Dismantling the upper cover of Turning gear.
Dismantling Epicyclic gear.
Dismantling Overruning clutch.
Dismantling Hydraulic Throwing gear.
Inspection
The validity of the anti-friction ball 
 bearings.
Check all parts for any worn-out and replace 
 them by new ones.
Inspect the run-out of shafts (allowance 0.03 
 mm).
Assembly
Insert new bearings on the clean shaft.
Install Hydraulic Throwing gear.
Install Overruning clutch.
Install Epicyclic gear.
Install the upper cover of Turning gear.
Insert new GUFERO rings with covers through 
 oiled shaft.
Install Hydrodynamical coujpling.
Install the covers of the bearings and seal 
 them against the bracket.
Install the shift in hydraulic part.
Put new gasket on position of Turning gear in 
 turbine.
After completing the assemblies attach carrying 
 rope to the upper Turning gear and put it on its position in turbine.
Screw in screw fixing bracket base to base 
 plate.
Connecting auxiliary piping of oil
Put electric motor on the Turning gear.
Install new pelt drive for the motor.
Starting of 
Turning 
Gear
Check the direction of rotation of
 turning gear before starting the 
 Turning gear for the first time.
Check the pressure of lubricating oil is 0.1 
 0.17 MPa.
Check revolution of turbine rotor is 70 72 
 rpm.
Attendance and checking 
during Operation

 in the bearing top which should not exceed 75C.

 gear.
Check lube oil pressure and level of oil tank.
Check the temperature of oil.
Check vibration for turning gear.
